module example.com/direct

go 1.26

-- main.go --
package main

/*
#include <stdint.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

#cgo LDFLAGS: -lm

#cgo noescape add_u64
#cgo nocallback add_u64
#cgo noescape mix_i
#cgo nocallback mix_i
#cgo noescape set_u32
#cgo nocallback set_u32
#cgo noescape narrow_i
#cgo nocallback narrow_i
#cgo noescape static_add
#cgo nocallback static_add
#cgo noescape block_until
#cgo nocallback block_until
#cgo noescape mix_fp
#cgo nocallback mix_fp
#cgo noescape scale_fp
#cgo nocallback scale_fp
#cgo noescape call_sin
#cgo nocallback call_sin
#cgo noescape errno_value
#cgo nocallback errno_value
#cgo noescape errno_void
#cgo nocallback errno_void
#cgo noescape add_pair
#cgo nocallback add_pair
#cgo noescape errno_pair
#cgo nocallback errno_pair

typedef struct {
	int64_t x;
	double y;
} pair_t;

uint64_t add_u64(uint64_t, uint64_t);
int64_t mix_i(int8_t, uint16_t, int32_t, uint64_t);
void set_u32(uint32_t *, uint32_t);
int8_t narrow_i(int8_t);
int32_t block_until(uint32_t *, uint32_t *);
double mix_fp(double, int32_t, float, uint64_t);
float scale_fp(float, double);
double call_sin(double);
int64_t errno_value(int64_t, int32_t);
void errno_void(int32_t);
pair_t add_pair(pair_t, pair_t);
pair_t errno_pair(pair_t, int32_t);

static uint32_t static_add(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
	return a + b;
}

static uint64_t may_callback(uint64_t value) {
	return value;
}
*/
import "C"
import (
	"runtime"
	"syscall"
	"sync/atomic"
	"unsafe"
)

var gate uint32
var entered uint32
var argumentOrder uint32

//go:noinline
func orderedArgument(value C.uint64_t, before uint32) C.uint64_t {
	if !atomic.CompareAndSwapUint32(&argumentOrder, before, before+1) {
		panic("C arguments evaluated out of order")
	}
	return value
}

//go:noinline
func replacement() {
	for atomic.LoadUint32(&entered) == 0 {
		runtime.Gosched()
	}
	atomic.StoreUint32(&gate, 1)
}

//go:noinline
func errnoCall(code C.int32_t) (C.int64_t, error) {
	value, err := C.errno_value(29, code)
	return value, err
}

//go:noinline
func pairCalls(iterations int) C.pair_t {
	value := C.pair_t{x: 1, y: 0.5}
	step := C.pair_t{x: 2, y: 0.25}
	for i := 0; i < iterations; i++ {
		value = C.add_pair(value, step)
	}
	return value
}

func main() {
	value := C.add_u64(orderedArgument(19, 0), orderedArgument(23, 1))
	callbackValue := C.may_callback(9)
	mixed := C.mix_i(-5, 600, -70000, 80000)
	var slot C.uint32_t
	C.set_u32(&slot, 77)
	narrow := C.narrow_i(-120)
	staticValue := C.static_add(30, 12)
	mixedFloat := C.mix_fp(0.5, -2, 1.25, 4)
	scaledFloat := C.scale_fp(1.5, 2)
	sine := C.call_sin(0.5)
	errnoValue, errnoErr := C.errno_value(17, C.EINVAL)
	_, nilErr := C.errno_value(18, 0)
	_, voidErr := C.errno_void(C.ENOENT)
	_, voidNil := C.errno_void(0)
	steadyErrnoValue, steadyErrnoErr := errnoCall(C.EBUSY)
	pair := pairCalls(3)
	errnoPair, pairErr := C.errno_pair(C.pair_t{x: 9, y: 1.5}, C.ERANGE)
	if argumentOrder != 2 || callbackValue != 9 || mixed != 10595 ||
		slot != 77 || narrow != -120 || staticValue != 42 ||
		mixedFloat != 3.75 || scaledFloat != 3 ||
		sine != sine || sine < 0.479425 || sine > 0.479426 ||
		errnoValue != 17 || errnoErr != syscall.EINVAL || nilErr != nil ||
		voidErr != syscall.ENOENT || voidNil != nil ||
		steadyErrnoValue != 29 || steadyErrnoErr != syscall.EBUSY ||
		pair.x != 7 || pair.y != 1.25 ||
		errnoPair.x != 9 || errnoPair.y != 1.5 || pairErr != syscall.ERANGE {
		panic("bad direct C ABI result")
	}
	go replacement()
	progress := C.block_until(
		(*C.uint32_t)(unsafe.Pointer(&gate)),
		(*C.uint32_t)(unsafe.Pointer(&entered)),
	)
	if progress != 1 || atomic.LoadUint32(&gate) != 1 ||
		atomic.LoadUint32(&entered) != 1 {
		panic("blocking C call stopped scheduler progress")
	}
	println(value)
}

-- add.c --
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

typedef struct {
	int64_t x;
	double y;
} pair_t;

uint64_t add_u64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
#if defined(__x86_64__)
	uintptr_t entry_sp = (uintptr_t)__builtin_frame_address(0) + sizeof(void *);
	if ((entry_sp & 15) != 8) {
		return UINT64_MAX;
	}
#endif
	return a + b;
}

int64_t mix_i(int8_t a, uint16_t b, int32_t c, uint64_t d) {
	return (int64_t)a + (int64_t)b + (int64_t)c + (int64_t)d;
}

void set_u32(uint32_t *p, uint32_t value) {
	*p = value;
}

int8_t narrow_i(int8_t value) {
	return value;
}

double mix_fp(double a, int32_t b, float c, uint64_t d) {
	return a + (double)b + (double)c + (double)d;
}

float scale_fp(float a, double b) {
	return a * (float)b;
}

double call_sin(double value) {
	return sin(value);
}

int64_t errno_value(int64_t value, int32_t error) {
	errno = error;
	return value;
}

void errno_void(int32_t error) {
	errno = error;
}

pair_t add_pair(pair_t a, pair_t b) {
	pair_t result = {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y};
	return result;
}

pair_t errno_pair(pair_t value, int32_t error) {
	errno = error;
	return value;
}

int32_t block_until(uint32_t *gate, uint32_t *entered) {
	time_t deadline = time(NULL) + 3;
	__atomic_store_n(entered, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
	while (__atomic_load_n(gate, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == 0) {
		if (time(NULL) >= deadline) {
			return 0;
		}
	}
	return 1;
}
